{{a|Keen Eye}} (as a Lycanroc; main story)Lycanroc can have any Ability native to its given form in the [[Battle Tree]] or [[Battle Royal Dome]]. |current=With [[Professor Kukui]] |evolution=1 |firstevoep=Generation VII |firstevoname=Pokémon Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon |firststagename=Rockruff |secondstagename=Lycanroc |prevonum=744 |evo1num=745 |media=game }} '''[[Professor Kukui]]'s {{p|Rockruff}} and {{p|Lycanroc}}''' (Japanese: '''ククイ博士のイワンコ/ルガルガン''' ''Dr. Kukui's Iwanko/Lugarugan'') are a group of Pokémon under Professor Kukui's ownership that have appeared in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. ==In the games== ===In the core series games=== [[Professor Kukui]] appears to own several Rockruff and Lycanroc in the games. He uses a Rockruff in [[Pokémon Sun and Moon|Pokémon Sun, Moon]], [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon]] to help with the capture, [[Z-Move]], and [[Battle Royal]] tutorials. He also uses a Midday Form Lycanroc in his battles against the {{player}} at the {{al|Pokémon League}}, a Midnight Form Lycanroc as the Masked Royal, and both forms in the [[Battle Tree]] in Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon. Another Rockruff can be seen in [[Alola Route 1|Professor Kukui's Lab]]. Like many of his other Pokémon, he often uses his Rockruff to use attacks on himself to help study for his research. In the process, this causes either the Pokémon Research Lab or his clothes to get damaged. The lab needs to be repaired and [[Lillie]] has to sew Kukui's clothes back together often. An example of this can be seen when Lillie walks the player to the lab to receive their [[Pokédex]]. Rockruff is known to chew on [[Nebby]]'s bed in Lillie's loft. {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |caption='''Capture tutorial

Professor Kukui and Lycanroc were first scoutable starting from January 30, 2020. {{PairDex/h|Rock}} {{PairDex|079|Kukui|trainerlink=Kukui (Masters)#Lycanroc (Midday Form)|trainerimg=Kukui|0745|Lycanroc|form={{Form|Lycanroc|Midday Form}}|gender=male|Rock|Water|Tech|6|Sync Pair Scout}} |} ==In animation== [[File:Pokémon Professors Masters Trailer.png|thumb|250px|Lycanroc in the animated trailer]] ===Main series=== {{main|Ash's Lycanroc}} {{Ash}}'s {{p|Lycanroc}} originally debuted as a wild {{p|Rockruff}} that sprung up around Kukui's lab one day. Although it was under Kukui's care, being provided with food and shelter, he never caught in a Poké Ball. In ''[[SM015|Rocking Clawmark Hill!]]'', Ash caught Rockruff and officially placed it under his ownership. ===Pokémon Masters Animated Trailer=== Professor Kukui's Lycanroc appeared alongside his Trainer in the [[Pokémon Masters Animated Trailer]]. {{-}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Kukui Rockruff Adventures.png|thumb|150px|As a Rockruff in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] [[File:Kukui Lycanroc Adventures.png|thumb|left|150px|Lycanroc in Pokémon Adventures]] Rockruff first appeared in ''[[PASM04|The Decision and the Tournament of Six]]'', under the ownership of [[Professor Kukui]]. It was first used to battle {{adv|Sun}}'s {{adv|Dollar}} at the [[Iki Town]] festival tournament. Initially, Rockruff had the advantage over Dollar due to Sun lacking the motivation to battle. Once Sun was given the proper motivation, he and Dollar easily defeated Rockruff, forcing Kukui to switch for {{p|Munchlax}}. Sometime later, it evolved into a Midday Form Lycanroc, and it was used to try and prevent a {{p|Celesteela}} and {{p|Guzzlord}} from reaching [[Hokulani Observatory]], only to be defeated. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|rock||Kukui Rockruff Rock Throw Adventures.png|Using Rock Throw as a Rockruff}} {{anmov|Rock|Rock Throw|PASM04|The Decision and the Tournament of Six}} {{anmov/f|rock}} ==In the TCG== A Rockruff belonging to Professor Kukui from the games also debuts as a full-art card in {{tcg|Silver Tempest}}.
